description.value: Pho Mimosa is a Vietnamese restaurant on Granville Street in downtown Vancouver, serving an extensive menu of pho, banh mi, specialty noodle soups, and appetizers. The restaurant is known for its long-simmered bone broth pho and a broad range of Vietnamese street food classics, from salad rolls and papaya salad to lemongrass grilled meats. Delivery is available through Uber Eats, DoorDash, and SkipTheDishes for cyclists who prefer food on the go.
